title: The dsh host sends a Model Subscription request's pictures inline, within one request budget, and declares what the pinned model reads
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/account-subscriptions-images.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/review-subscription-images.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: The run request carries {type:'image', source:{type:'base64'}} after a text handle, and no 'attachment' reference; the caller's messages are not mutated.
25 pictures of 512 KiB base64 each fail with IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED and failure.offloadImages = 9; the retry with 9 offloaded reads 16 pictures, sends 16 images and 9 placeholders.
The same reference twice is read once and counted twice; 21 occurrences need 1 offload.
A picture above 1 MiB is asked again at 1536 then 1024, and kept at 1024.
A fallback to the deployment default streams the original reference messages.
A pin with route.inputModalities ['text','image'] makes seat-plan-claude declare image before the route reaches dsh; glm, a silent or malformed pin, and a cold host declare ['text'].
view.mjs agentReadsImages and look.mjs readsImages are true on a Claude route and false on GLM.
evidence: Review 09/10/2026: a pasted screenshot or page picture never reached a subscription model; the host posted store references tracy-web cannot read.
fence: REQUEST_IMAGE_BUDGET (8 MiB base64, 20 occurrences) via requiredImageOffload; the pin-filled modality cache

tests: a pasted picture reaches tracy-web as base64 bytes, never as a store reference
a tool result picture (page.look) is sent inline too, in its place
25 pictures over 8 MiB of base64 ask dsh to offload the oldest; the retry sends the rest without reading the offloaded
the same picture twice is read once and counted twice
a picture still above 1 MiB after compression is asked again smaller: 1536, then 1024
a fallback to the deployment default re-sends the original store references, not the inline copy
a pinned vendor model declares what tracy-web says it reads: Claude pictures, GLM text
after a host restart a model reads pictures again from its first pin
Tracy's own picture checks (page picture, page.look) see a Claude route read pictures, and a GLM route not
